description: On a green tablecloth there’s a small stack of colorful saucer-sized plates near the right side of the surface. The right hand reaches in from the right, lifts the top yellow plate off the stack, sets it down to the right, then slides the blue plate leftward before lifting and placing a green plate near the center and leaving the red plate in front, ending with the four plates spread out and the hand hovering near the yellow one.
